messages:
leo_finance: Quick check: rolling PriceSheet v4 to cohort B tomorrow. need ledger->invoice parity and grandfathering rule validation.

tara_billing: uploading sample extract now. parity tolerance?

leo_finance: cohort tolerance <$0.30/account/day. outreach trigger > $60.

jamie_ops: ops requests a staging deploy window and rollback plan if >1% invoices fail.

olga_growth: confirm phased-grandfathering: 3-cycle taper using field `phase_pct`. do not drop credits immediately.

ryan_sales: +1 on outreach. prefer auto-credit > $100, manual review 60-100. send top-15 if any.

billing-bot: snapshot saved: s3://redwood-billing/pricewave/v4/snap-2026-03-15T04-00Z/ledger.csv

tara_billing: found vendor_fee unit mismatch for vendor=fast-path (some rows cents, some dollars).

jamie_ops: will hotfix transformer to normalize vendor_fee -> cents and deploy to staging (~25m).

tara_billing: also noticed rounding mismatch: ledger uses bankers, invoice generator used round-half-up. will align to bankers.

leo_finance: please hold cohort B toggle until finance+sales signoff. tara, post delta CSV after staging run. ryan, i'll tag you for outreach draft.

ryan_sales: got it. ready to review top-15 and draft message.
